objective: Measure the coalescing/control contribution of frozen M216 SOURCE_CAP=8 plus frozen M218 against a deliberately strong equal-peak-bandwidth K1x8 implementation, while closing the M345 service-SVA, out-of-order-evidence, cross-architecture-multiset, and cycle-race findings.

boundary.input: raw FC2 activity: ordered beat index plus 96-bit bitmap, four beats per accepted packet
boundary.output: raw signed Acc24 FC2 accumulator, six 16-lane slices per output block
boundary.numeric_boundary: signed INT8 weights accumulated into signed Acc24; no scale, requantization, BN2, or SN2
includes: candidate frozen M216 SOURCE_CAP=8 plus frozen M218 O8/FIFO4 tagged service
baseline frozen M216 SOURCE_CAP=8 lossless dispatcher plus eight frozen M219 K1 O8/FIFO4 tagged services
eight logical 128-bit weight banks and fixed L4 response generation
atomic eight-lane Acc24 result join for the K1x8 baseline
request-ID out-of-order scoreboards and expanded transaction multisets

equal_bandwidth_baseline.candidate: one M218 request may carry one active word from each of eight logical banks
equal_bandwidth_baseline.baseline: eight independent M219 scalar lanes may each issue one word from its corresponding logical bank per cycle
equal_bandwidth_baseline.baseline_service_capacity: O64/FIFO32 aggregate; intentionally stronger than candidate
equal_bandwidth_baseline.same_response_allow_trajectory: edge_ordinal modulo 17 is at least 5; 12 visible cycles per 17

evidence_repairs.service_sva: m218_fc2_tagged_slice_service_assertions is bound into the candidate service and m219_fc2_k1_cropped_tagged_slice_service_assertions is bound into all eight baseline services
evidence_repairs.out_of_order: per-slot request-ID scoreboards require an accepted response generation to be younger than at least one still-live generation
evidence_repairs.cross_architecture_equivalence: request and response multisets compare block, slice, channel, implied bank=channel[2:0], exact per-lane weight, and committed result
evidence_repairs.cycle_definition: one posedge monitor exclusively owns both header-accept start and token-done-accept end; inclusive cycles=end_edge-start_edge+1
evidence_repairs.fail_closed: protocol, identity, conservation, numeric, multiset, service-SVA, and coverage failures reject the run

red_lines: The earlier 5.281x geomean compares K8 against a serialized K1 service and is not an equal-bandwidth coalescing/control speedup.
The strongest observed equal-peak-bandwidth cycle ratio in this directed standalone scope is 1.0x, not a positive speedup.
This diagnostic does not invalidate possible area, control-energy, or SRAM-command advantages; none are measured here.
